examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'gangster, bandit' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Такая интересная. Я тебе не бандит.
examples.trans: Funny you should say that. I'm no gangster for you.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

examples.text: Надо бежать! Беги в деревню к маме.
examples.trans: You need to run! Run to the village to your mum's.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
Go on, tell her. Nina doesn't believe it.
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Вы ничего не делаете без личной выгоды.
examples.trans: You don't do anything without personal gain.
What benefit is there in this for me?

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go out, to get out', paired with 'выходить'.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.en: money, cash (colloquial/affectionate plural diminutive of деньги)
meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'money, cash (affectionate diminutive of деньги)' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!

examples.text: Я за комнаткой пригляжу. Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: I'll look after the little room. Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
Gum? I didn't have enough money.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: в долгу не остаться = to repay a favour

examples.text: Помогите мне! Я в долгу не останусь.
examples.trans: Help me! I'll pay you back, I promise.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: for a door or a car

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.en: small room, little room (diminutive of комната)
meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'little room (diminutive of комната)' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I'll look after the little room.
He has a small, cosy little room.

examples.text: Я за комнаткой пригляжу. Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: I'll look after the little room. Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!

контролировать.gloss: to control, to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to supervise, to keep an eye on, to control

examples.trans: I'm supposed to keep an eye on you!
Keep an eye on me right here!

examples.text: А слепые? Я же тебя контролировать должна!
examples.trans: What about the blind people? I'm supposed to keep an eye on you!
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('personal, private').

examples.text: Всё, Нинок. Теперь у нас есть личный слуга.
examples.trans: That's it, Ninok. Now we have our own personal servant.

meanings.note: used to address a child you don't know

examples.trans: I thought maybe you wouldn't see me.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

related.gloss: intensified / related adverb (it is not allowed)

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

одеваться.gloss: to get dressed, to dress oneself

meanings.en: to get dressed, to put on one's clothes
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to get dressed, to dress oneself', paired with 'одеться'.

examples.trans: Lyonya! Get up and get dressed quickly!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: And the advance stays with us.

meanings.note: оставь мне кусок = save me a piece
оставь мне кусок = save me a piece

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

examples.text: Вика, ну он одинокий. Я же не оставлю его одного.
examples.trans: Vika, come on, he's all alone. I can't just leave him on his own.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to review', paired with 'повторить'.

examples.text: Ещё раз повторяю, я решил вашу проблему.
examples.trans: I repeat once again, I solved your problem.

examples.text: Каждый день ты повторяешь одно и то же.
examples.trans: Every day you repeat the same thing.

поделить.gloss: to divide, to split, to share out

meanings.en: to divide up, to split, to share between

meanings.note: пока не поздно = before it's too late

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!

examples.text: Беги, Марина, пока не поздно! А ключи можешь мне оставить.
examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late! And you can leave me the keys.

meanings.note: as a conjunction: пока я сплю

пополам.gloss: in half, fifty-fifty, equally between two

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'полам').

examples.trans: And we'll split the money fifty-fifty!
We split the bill in half.

examples.text: Я за комнаткой пригляжу. Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: I'll look after the little room. Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

приглядеть.gloss: to look after, to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: I'll look after the little room.
Please keep an eye on the child.

examples.text: Я за комнаткой пригляжу. Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: I'll look after the little room. Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to be in hiding
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hide (oneself)', paired with 'спрятаться'.

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to scare, frighten', paired with 'испугать'.

examples.text: Первый раз вижу, чтобы людей удочкой пугали.
examples.trans: It's the first time I've seen anyone scare people with a fishing rod.

meanings.note: + infinitive: решил стать = decided to become

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

сдать.gloss: to return, to hand in; to pass (an exam)

meanings.en: to return, to hand back, to turn in
meanings.note: a rented car, key, or ticket

examples.text: Нам надо сдать машину до десяти часов.
examples.trans: We have to return the car before ten o'clock.

examples.text: Я за комнаткой пригляжу. Может, сдам кому, а денежки пополам!
examples.trans: I'll look after the little room. Maybe I'll rent it to someone, and we'll split the money!

meanings.note: Borrowed via French/German from Medieval Latin 'situatio' (position, state of affairs, from 'situs').

examples.trans: This is a very complicated situation.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to take cover

examples.text: Вы вообще в свою комнату спрятались!
examples.trans: You hid in your own room altogether!
The cat hid under the bed.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'too, also' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: plural-only noun: эти часы = this watch

examples.text: Видишь эти часы? Это швейцарское золото.
examples.trans: See this watch? It's Swiss gold.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
